synopsis.text: Kulan Gath is holding a celebration with the Avengers prisoners, using Peliali in an attempt to achieve godhood as Wasp meets with the president of Costa Verde. Silverclaw recongizes an old friend and nearly convinces her that it's real, only to fail as a guard attacks her. The Avengers get free and attack, gaining support from the military and eventually the townspeople. In the end, the Avengers prevail, though Peliali died. In the end, Silverclaw is promoted as a reserve Avenger. It is revealed that what appears to be Yellowjacket is hiding on the ship with them, though Giant-Man is with them.
